intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A folded paper owl lands beside Tavri and hoots once. Then it unfolds itself into a glowing scroll.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Ah. Fantasygram. This week’s public humiliation, delivered by express owl.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “The palace has an account. I’m its public-relations emergency.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: On the scroll, Tavri hurries away from a banquet table.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The caption reads *Princess Flees Dinner After Losing Fight with Napkin.*

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “I was helping a servant with a spilled tray! There was gravy on the ceiling!”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “They cropped out the servant. They cropped out the tray. They kept the napkin.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “The crop tool. Most dangerous spell in the kingdom.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Finally, a scholar who understands modern sorcery. Point to you.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A second paper owl lands. Its scroll is titled *Ten Reasons the Princess Is Secretly Unfit for Polite Society.*

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Ten! Busy week. Number one’s the napkin, I assume. Number two, also the napkin.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Number three, ‘laughs like a goose.’ Fair. Number four—”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She stops reading. Her tail has wrapped itself tight around her ankles.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “If I joke about it first, nobody notices it bothered me. That’s the usual plan.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Badly. I’m out of napkin material. Your move.”

options.labelText: “Skip the joke. It’s a rotten scroll. Want to tell people the gravy story, or ignore it with me?”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “You’d let me pick? Even if it’s profoundly unprincesslike?”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Then I’d like to put the scroll away and be upset for one minute.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She puts it away. You wait out the minute with her. Nobody says anything clever.

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: Then the paper owl folds itself into a napkin. A visibly judgmental napkin.

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She laughs at a napkin. Loudly. She doesn’t check who heard.

options.labelText: “It’s just gossip. Hit back with something funnier and everyone will forget it.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Something funnier. Yes. That’s what I normally do.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Of course you were. I was hoping for the other one.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She pockets the scroll. The joke she makes about it later is excellent.

options.labelText: “Maybe they’ve got a point. A competent princess wouldn’t give them material.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Number eleven. Thank you. That saves them an owl.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She rolls up both scrolls and goes.
